card.name: Words right before an abstract noun
card.fires_on: Short linking words or adjectives (is, was, with, following, sexual, certain) that sit just before an abstract noun or a verb phrase naming a process, such as abstinence, distance, thawing or death.

modes.label: Linking verbs and prepositions
modes.description: A verb like is or was, or a preposition like with, that leads into a goal or a change over a quantity.
modes.example: his immediate goal<< was>> to re-establish the “greater China”

modes.label: Following before an event
modes.description: The word following, used as a time marker before an event or procedure noun.
modes.example: 0 to 30 minutes<< following>> the administration of Sodium Pertechnet

modes.label: Adjective before an abstract noun
modes.description: An adjective that precedes a noun ending in -ence or -tion.
modes.example: The only way to prevent sexually-transmitted HPV infections 100 percent is<< sexual>> abstinence.

card.writes: It favors nouns ending in -tion, -ment or -ism and suppresses short concrete words such as penalty, origin or balance.
card.plain: It marks a small linking word that is about to be followed by an abstract noun naming a process or state.
